CustomField.description: Audience filter for the page. FormTemplate_Utility builds a visibility set from the running user's type and includes the page only when its Visibility is in that set: 'Both' always shows; 'Internal Only' shows for Standard (internal Salesforce) users; 'External Only' shows for Experience Cloud / guest users. Cloning ignores this filter and copies all pages. Restricted picklist, default 'Both', required. Use it to serve different page sets to staff vs. portal respondents from one template.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose who sees this page: Both (everyone), Internal Only (logged-in Salesforce/staff users), or External Only (Experience Cloud/portal respondents). Use it to show or hide a page based on audience from a single template; leave it on Both unless a page is meant for only one group.
CustomField.label: Visibility
